title: Two Gloucester schools in lockdown after boy hurt in incident
originalTitle: Two Gloucester schools in lockdown after boy hurt in incident
content:
Two schools are in lockdown as armed police search for a group of people involved in an altercation that left a boy injured.

One male was seen with a "long-bladed item" during the incident outside St Peter's High School in Gloucester earlier, police said.

Armed officers are now searching for a group involved who fled the area. The force said one boy had been taken to hospital with minor injuries.

The Tuffley school and nearby Willow Primary Academy are locked down and officers asked parents not to attend. A police spokesperson said there was "no ongoing threat at the school" and pupils were safe within the school grounds.

Adam, whose daughter attends St Peter's, said he felt frightened even though he had texted her and knew she was OK.

"I don't think this should happen at school. Thank God she is safe," he added.

The school had messaged parents to say everything was under control, he added.
